caption_draft:
These 6 AI coding tools have a free way in.

GitHub Copilot — https://github.com/features/copilot/plans — 2,000 free completions a month
Amazon Q Developer — https://aws.amazon.com/q/developer/pricing/ — 50 free agent requests a month
JetBrains AI — https://lp.jetbrains.com/ai-ides-faq/ — Unlimited code completion, free tier
Cursor — https://cursor.com/pricing — Free plan with agent requests
Cline — https://github.com/cline/cline — 71.7k stars on GitHub
Continue — https://github.com/continuedev/continue — 36.5k stars on GitHub

Save this for your next project. Send it to a friend who codes late at night.

#ai #coding #copilot #developer #firstyear #students #programming #notyourcollege
